subject: Trading
title: Double Top and Bottom
description: Learn Double Top and Bottom in one minute.

hook.text: A stock rallies to $80, drops, rallies back to $80, and drops again. Two failed attempts—double top confirmed.

buildup.text: Double tops form when price tests a resistance level twice and fails. Each failure weakens buyer conviction.

discovery.text: The pattern confirms when price breaks below the valley between the two peaks—the neckline.

twist.text: Double bottoms are the bullish mirror. Two bounces off the same support signal strong buying demand.

climax.text: Double patterns work because they show the market testing a level and the level winning—twice.

punchline.text: Fail the same level twice? The market remembers.

quiz.question: When is a double top confirmed?
options: When price breaks below the valley between the two peaks
